title: Community Reports and Crowd Intelligence on SyNexus
excerpt: How operator reports improve Sentinel awareness — without replacing your own verification.
author: SyNexus Editorial
trustLine: Non-custodial · You sign every trade · Not financial advice.

blocks.text: Signed-in users can report suspicious tokens from detail pages. Reports feed Cipher and broader scoring so repeat motifs surface faster for everyone.
Crowd flags can be wrong or malicious. SyNexus weighs reports alongside on-chain heuristics — never treat a report count as proof by itself.
